facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the Copperbelt SMART Zambia Unit trained 31 government officers from over a dozen institutions on 20 August 2025 in Mufulira on the Citizens' Portal, ZamPortal and Government Mail.

ZMB.note: Training was for government officers only.
Training of officers is other; no statement on who runs the systems.
A council chamber was only the venue; no council connection stated.
Police officers attended a general ICT training; no station record system stated.
